what: PROPOSED decision record for reviewer round pointing-typical-1. NOT PLACED. The orchestrator splices this into research/v3/data/decisions/decisions.json; this file exists because decisions.json is tracked and a history rewrite is live on this branch.
proposedBy: scoring pass over pointing-typical-1, POINTING_TYPICAL_VERDICT.md sec 16

decisions.draftedAs: verdict - POINTING_TYPICAL_PREREG.md sec 6.4 specified the four readings and their consequences before the GPU run made a single point (committed bafcc53). Branch 2 fired. The record transcribes the pre-registered consequence rather than composing a new one, and the branch text is quoted verbatim in the decision.
decisions.scope: Whether the pointing->SAM route carries forward as the ground route for the v3 semantic oracle, and the standing of POINTING_PROBE_NOTES.md sec 13.6's `route-alive-pending-typical-strata-probe`. NO CODE CHANGES BY THIS RECORD: DEFAULT_SELECTION stays `containing`, SELECT_GROUND and segment_ground_union stay in point_prompt.py as callable non-default policies, no constant moves, nothing is deleted. It does not settle whether the residual route works - that is measured elsewhere - and it does not retire sec 13.9's caveat that these are answer-rates, not correctness.
decisions.decision: POINTING->SAM DOES NOT CARRY FORWARD AS A GROUND ROUTE, UNDER ANY OF THE THREE SELECTION POLICIES. The pre-registered bar (POINTING_TYPICAL_PREREG.md sec 6, committed bafcc53 before inference) was a conjunction: B1 dot-right >= 12/16 AND, for at least one policy, dot-right-and-wash-right >= 8/16. B1 PASSED at 13/16. B2 FAILED for all three policies - containing 1/16, ground 2/16, union 2/16, against a bar of 8/16, a miss of six covers by the best policy. B3, the conjunction, therefore FAILED. sec 13.6 left the route 'alive' ONLY pending this probe; this round IS that probe, and it resolves against the route. THE STATUS `route-alive-pending-typical-strata-probe` IS HEREBY CLOSED AND REPLACED BY `route-not-carried-forward`. THE POINTER IS NOT THE DEFECT AND THIS IS NOT `route-dead`: sec 6.4's route-dead branch requires B1 to fail and it did not. 13 of 16 covers are dot-right, and only ONE cover carries a genuine dot-wrong answer - the other two B1 failures are covers answered `can't tell` on all three tiles and scored dot-wrong by the pre-registered tie rule. Among the 14 covers with any decidable tile the pointer is right on 13. THE WASH IS A ROUTE-LEVEL DEFECT, NOT A HARD-TAIL ARTIFACT - sec 6.4 branch 2, verbatim: 'the pointer is fine and the wash fails on ordinary covers too - the sec 14 repairs do not generalise. Stop point-prompt engineering; sec 14.8's third clause fires and the residual route is the answer.' CONSEQUENCE, AS PRE-REGISTERED: point-prompt engineering STOPS. No further phrasing work (sec 12.3 searched that space), no further selection-policy work, and no GPU slot is spent on pointing. THE sec 13 ANCHOR STANDS UNMOVED: 'it wasn't amazing.'
decisions.fundingCaveats: NO INDEPENDENT ANSWER KEY. Typical covers have no ground-freetext-1 prose, so all 48 labels are one reviewer's judgement and nothing here is validated against a second source; sec 13.9's caveat is not retired by this record. The round is one reviewer, n=16, in 5.5 minutes. Two answers are revision-2 re-grades (both `can't tell` -> a definite answer) and are cited at their latest revision, so an amendment to either flags this record. EIGHT OF 48 TILES ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL DUPLICATES, so the three per-policy numbers are correlated and not independent - see the next record. B1's pass, which is the half this record leans on for 'the pointer is not the defect', does NOT depend on the duplicates: the dot is a property of the cover and was scored once per cover by construction.

decisions.draftedAs: analysis of an instrument - POINTING_TYPICAL_PREREG.md sec 4 built the three-policy design so 'the reviewer's keypress separates the policy from the pointer'. It did not, and the reason is measurable rather than arguable. Recorded separately from the route verdict because it constrains how any FUTURE three-arm round is built, and would survive even if the route verdict were reversed.
decisions.scope: The evidential standing of the per-policy numbers in pointing-typical-1, and the sec 14.7 addition-3 design of scoring policies as separate tiles on identical points. It changes no code and no constant. It does NOT say the policies are equivalent in general - it says this round did not measure a difference.
decisions.decision: THE THREE-POLICY COMPARISON RETURNED NO USABLE SIGNAL, AND THE PER-POLICY SPREAD IS SMALLER THAN THE ROUND'S OWN NOISE FLOOR. THE COMPARISON HAS CONTENT ON ONLY 9 OF 16 COVERS - on the other 7, SELECT_GROUND picked the same candidate as SELECT_CONTAINING and the two panels are byte-identical images (8 duplicate tiles, 40 distinct images across 48 tiles; on 0000cb59, the single-point cover, all three policies collapse to one mask). ON 8 OF THOSE 9 INFORMATIVE COVERS ALL THREE POLICIES DREW THE SAME KEYPRESS. Exactly one cover, 0005597105ba1e2d38f62cfc, is a genuine policy win: containing dot-right/wash-wrong, ground and union both-right - and that cover is one of the five with a POINTS SHORTFALL (2 distinct points, not the 3 sec 14.7 asked for). THE REST OF THE SPREAD IS ANSWER NOISE ON IDENTICAL IMAGES: of the 7 byte-identical pairs, 5 were answered identically and 2 WERE NOT. ground's second both-right (0010b864) is a byte-identical twin of a containing tile answered dot-right/wash-wrong, and containing's ONLY both-right (00124d05) is a revision-2 re-grade whose byte-identical ground twin was answered `can't tell`. STRIP THE DUPLICATES AND THE INFORMATIVE-COVER SCORE IS containing 0/9, ground 1/9, union 1/9. NO POLICY IS PROMOTED AND NONE IS CONDEMNED ON THIS EVIDENCE. CONSEQUENCE FOR FUTURE ROUNDS: A THREE-ARM ROUND MUST BE BUILT ON COVERS WHERE THE ARMS PRODUCE DIFFERENT MASKS, checked before the round is pushed, or most of its tiles buy nothing; and where duplicates are unavoidable they should be scored as a declared intra-reviewer consistency check rather than as three independent arms.
decisions.fundingCaveats: The 2-of-7 inconsistency rate is n=7 and is a floor on the noise, not an estimate of it - it can only detect inconsistency where duplicates happened to exist, and the duplicates were not designed. It was READ as a consistency check after the fact, per sec 15.3, not designed as one. The informative/duplicate split is derived from sha256 over the stored mask RLE, recomputed in score_pointing_typical_1.py rather than taken from the run file's own same_candidate_as_containing flag; the two agree on all 16 covers.

decisions.draftedAs: verdict - POINTING_TYPICAL_PREREG.md sec 6.2 wrote B4 as a separate and stricter bar before the data, closing sec 14.5's open clause 'the default moves when the typical-strata probe says so'. The probe has spoken. Recorded so the open clause is visibly closed rather than left dangling.
decisions.scope: The value of DEFAULT_SELECTION in research/v3/oracle/sam/point_prompt.py. NO CODE CHANGE: it is already `containing` and stays `containing`. SELECT_GROUND and segment_ground_union remain implemented and callable; this record does not remove them.
decisions.decision: DEFAULT_SELECTION STAYS `containing`. NEITHER CHALLENGER QUALIFIED, AND EACH FAILED B4 ON ITS FIRST CLAUSE. B4 required all three of: clears B2; beats containing by >= 3 covers of 16; breaks at most 1 already-passing cover. `ground` cleared none of B2 (2/16 vs 8/16), beat containing by +1 (bar +3), and broke 1 already-passing cover (00124d05). `union` cleared none of B2 (2/16 vs 8/16), beat containing by +1 (bar +3), and broke 0. THE PREREG'S OWN CLAUSE APPLIES VERBATIM: 'Failing B4 while clearing B2 is not a promotion' - and neither challenger even cleared B2. THIS IS NOT A WIN FOR `containing`. It scored 1/16, the LOWEST of the three, and its single both-right cover is a re-graded answer to an image whose byte-identical twin was answered `can't tell`. The default stays put because the pre-registered bar to move it was not met, NOT because the incumbent was vindicated. ONE POSITIVE FINDING, RECORDED BECAUSE IT WAS PRE-REGISTERED AS A THING THAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: sec 14.8's second clause - the worry that a union rule 'costs more single-region covers than the multi-region covers it buys', the 00030075 worry - DID NOT FIRE. `union` broke ZERO already-passing covers and its masks sat in the [0.05, 0.85] ground band on 16/16 covers, where `containing` fell outside it on 3. That is a real if small negative result about union's failure mode, and it is the only part of the sec 14 repair programme this round supports.
decisions.fundingCaveats: Same duplicate correlation as the previous record: the +1 margins and the 'breaks 0 / breaks 1' counts are computed over 16 covers of which only 9 carry any policy contrast, and both of the broken/gained covers outside those 9 are duplicate-tile answer noise. The band statistics (16/16 vs 13/16 in band) are PROXIES from the run file, not reviewer answers; the prereg is explicit that the bar is human and the proxies decide nothing.
